selected_model.name: XGBoost + Clean Transformer Late Fusion Hybrid

primary_metric.name: PR-AUC
primary_metric.rationale: Recommended primary metric for highly imbalanced medical screening cohorts (~3.7-4.3% prevalence).

secondary_metrics.name: Unique Positive Children Detected
secondary_metrics.function: Distinct positive children with at least one true positive visit alert

locked_decision_threshold.threshold_role: Exploratory Research Alert Threshold (Balanced Screening Target)
locked_decision_threshold.warning: This is strictly an exploratory research operating threshold derived from the validation cohort. It is NOT an approved clinical alert threshold and must not be used for medical decisions.

documented_limitations.detail: 293 sparse columns in the tabular branch represent exact calendar dates (2018-2022). Unseen birth dates evaluate to all zeros.
Hybrid scores blend unweighted XGBoost and 22:1 class-weighted Transformer scores. Blended values are ranking indices, not true clinical probabilities.
Visits without follow-up encounters in (0, 180] days were defaulted to 0 (interval-censored).

documented_limitations.issue: Unknown real vs. synthetic child provenance
documented_limitations.detail: Dataset combines ~400 real clinic records and ~100 synthetic profiles whose exact parameters are undocumented.
Validation contains 42 positive events (24 children); test contains 50 positive events. Small positive counts widen bootstrap confidence intervals.

execution_rules.disclose_prior_access: An earlier baseline reproduction was performed in Stage 10; disclosed transparently.
